newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX crude dips, follows NYMEX on bearish API.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX crude dips, follows NYMEX on bearish API.

text.p: SIMEX Brent crude futures dipped on Wednesday, tracking NYMEX which fell after bearish API data.
August Brent crude last traded at $17.80 per barrel, down seven cents from overnight London.
Both London and New York fell overnight after Iraq oil minister Amir Rasheed said in Madrid that the country would resume oil exports in seven to 10 days.
But API added to the downside, August NYMEX on ACCESS was pushed lower to be last quoted at $18.98, five cents below New York's close.
Traders said continued high refinery runs captured the market's attention, although gasoline demand appeared strong.
OPEC was having little affect on prices as major members said they favoured a roll over of quotas. But headline trading could prompt some modest volatility during the day.
